def test_r3_column_names_from_columns_prefix():
    a = [1, 2, 3]
    for n in (1, 2, 3, 4, 5):
        ax = task_func(a, list(range(n)))
        legend = ax.get_legend()
        assert legend is not None
        names = [t.get_text() for t in legend.get_texts()]
        assert names == COLUMNS[:n]

def _bar_heights(ax):
    """Heights of the bar patches of the axes, in drawing order."""
    return [float(p.get_height()) for p in ax.patches]

def test_r4_values_are_random():
    a = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]
    ax = task_func(a, [1, 2, 3])
    heights = _bar_heights(ax)
    assert len(heights) == 18
    assert len(set(heights)) > 1

def _bar_heights(ax):
    """Heights of the bar patches of the axes, in drawing order."""

def test_r4_values_differ_between_calls():
    a = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]
    first = _bar_heights(task_func(a, [1, 2, 3]))
    second = _bar_heights(task_func(a, [1, 2, 3]))
    assert first != second

def test_r5_bar_chart_patches():
    a = [1, 2, 3]
    ax = task_func(a, [1, 2])
    assert len(ax.patches) == 6
    for patch in ax.patches:
        assert hasattr(patch, "get_height")
        assert hasattr(patch, "get_width")
        assert float(patch.get_width()) > 0
    # a bar chart has no line data
    assert len(ax.lines) == 0

def test_r3_row_count_matches_len_a():
    a = ["r0", "r1", "r2", "r3"]
    ax = task_func(a, [1, 2])
    # one bar per (row, column) pair
    assert len(ax.patches) == len(a) * 2

    ax = task_func(a, [1, 2])
    labels = [t.get_text() for t in ax.get_xticklabels()]
    assert labels == a

def test_r5_column_count_matches_len_b():
    ax = task_func(["x", "y"], [1, 2, 3])
    # 2 rows x 3 columns -> 6 bars
    assert len(ax.patches) == 6

def test_r4_bars_are_grouped_per_row():
    a = ["r1", "r2", "r3"]
    ax = task_func(a, [1, 2])
    # Bars belonging to the same row share the same x position.
    xs = [round(float(p.get_x()), 6) for p in ax.patches]
    n = len(a)
    first_series = xs[:n]
    second_series = xs[n:2 * n]
    assert len(set(first_series)) == n
    assert len(set(second_series)) == n
    # The two series are offset from each other (grouped, not stacked).
    assert set(first_series).isdisjoint(set(second_series))
